rows.text: SPA, Riyadh 30 Dhu al-Qa'da 1428 / 10 December 2007: King Abdullah received at his Riyadh palace 'مساء امس' (yesterday evening) the sons of the founder, led by Prince Mishaal bin Abdulaziz and Crown Prince Sultan bin Abdulaziz, with sons and grandsons of the deceased sons, and addressed them.
